fixes.text: Share a remote cache for turbo.json: it has none in CI
Each job spends 1.1 minutes on setup: cache dependencies and build once
"E2E (iOS)" runs 15 min in one job: shard it
9% of PR heads went green only on a rerun: track and fix flakes
Setup on the critical path: 6.3 min of setup in jobs that first wait on others; start it while they wait, and wait only for the step you need
Cancel superseded PR runs: no concurrency with cancel-in-progress
867 cached tasks declare no inputs, such as @capawesome-team/capacitor-android-battery-optimization#build: declare each one's inputs, so an edit it doesn't read keeps its cache
A chain of 7 tasks runs one after another on a cache miss: cut the `dependsOn` edges a task doesn't need
